messages:
Ava R.: kicking off onboarding for model rwd-v3.1-int4. plan: small canary -> ramp -> promote with auto-fallback. looking for concrete gating numbers (mrr, hallucination, latency) and soft-fallback variants.
Sam K.: propose initial canary: 3% for 1h, then 10% for 2h. monitor mrr@5, hallucination_rate, p95 latency. fallback if mrr drops >0.6% abs OR hallucination increases >2.0pp absolute. keep sample sizes per slice >= 500.
Priya N.: baseline (v3.0): mrr@5=0.412, hallucination_rate=0.9% (longdoc slice higher). my suggested auto-fallback thresholds: abs mrr drop >=0.6% within 30m window OR hallucination_rate >=2.5% absolute OR p95 latency increase >250ms. also require no regression on our longdoc MRR slice.
Jules T.: note: int4 can cause KV-warmup transient regressions during cold caches. recommend soft-fallback to v3.1-nf4 variant first (same weights, different quant) before full rollback to v3.0. preserves semantic improvements while isolating quant artifacts.
Ava R.: agree on soft-fallback. also add noise guard/consistency check across slices before promoting. ops-bot, can you render a compact rollout policy we can paste into the runbook?
ops-bot: posting rollout policy snippet below:
```json
{"canary_steps":[{"pct":3,"duration_mins":60},{"pct":10,"duration_mins":120}],"fallback_rules":[{"metric":"mrr@5","delta_abs":"-0.006","window_mins":30},{"metric":"hallucination_rate","threshold":"0.025"},{"metric":"p95_latency_ms","delta_abs":"250"}],"soft_fallback_variant":"v3.1-nf4","min_samples_per_slice":500,"noise_guard_stdev_threshold":0.002}
```
Priya N.: also add a conservatism flag: if any critical slice entropy changes > 0.01, hold and escalate to ML oncall.
Sam K.: starting smoke eval now (short-answer, longdoc, rerank). will post A/B table in ~30m.
ops-bot: canary started by Sam K. at 2025-11-12T15:04:00Z (ts 1776549999).
Sam K.: smoke results (30m window): overall mrr delta = -0.005 (-0.5% abs), p=0.12; hallucination +0.9pp; p95 latency +80ms. per-slice: longdoc mrr -0.008, short-answer stable.
Ava R.: borderline but not catastrophic. extend 3% step by +2h to collect more longdoc samples. enable soft-fallback to v3.1-nf4 automatically if mrr crosses -0.006 abs in next 30m.
Priya N.: prepping cross-cohort stats and running an extended smoke with seeded longdocs. will also run structured-output fidelity checks.
Jules T.: ops: please add canary tag so we can trace client-side failures. also ensure KV-warmup logs are captured.
Sam K.: noted. I'll push updated rollout config with soft-fallback and extended window. posting final numbers once extended run completes.
Ava R.: thanks team. if extended run still shows longdoc mrr < -0.006 we'll trigger soft-fallback; full rollback only if soft-fallback doesn't stabilize within 30m. ping me if auto actions fire.
end
